ctx.x: So, he said ... but he didn't know Joe so Lil said, he said to her, Who's that cat on trumpet playing my tune? So she said, That's Joe Thomas. He recorded all these tunes with me and he also recorded "Just for a Thrill." And she told me he said, Play it over. So she played it again. So she said when the record was over Pops was jubilant. He said, Wow, this cat can really blow and he's making me mad because now I'm going to have to go and really record this tune. I've got to record my own tune cause he's going to…
